description: Conservative, token-driven mobile UX polish layered on the single TopBar from FEAT-001 (depends on FEAT-001's .topbar-* classes). Adds ~44px touch tap targets and tightens board/dialog spacing and overflow on small screens by EXTENDING existing base.css breakpoints — no feature, data-flow, or desktop-layout redesign.
steps: In src/styles/base.css add a touch block `@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)` that raises min-height to ~44px (and adequate vertical padding) on the primary bar tab buttons (.topbar-tabs button), the account-control buttons (.header-auth-btn and the Appearance/Members buttons — target via a class if one is added, otherwise via the existing .header-auth-btn plus the icon button sizes), and the BoardViewToggle buttons. Additive only — no color changes, no effect on pointer:fine desktops.

If needed to hit 44px cleanly on the Appearance/Members icon/secondary buttons, add a shared className (e.g. className="account-btn") to those buttons in src/components/AccountControls.tsx and target it in the touch media block — do NOT change their behavior, labels, aria, or token colors.

In src/styles/base.css tighten board spacing at <=860px: reduce .board-main padding slightly for small screens so content isn't cramped, keeping the single-column collapse and schedule -> details -> list order intact.

In src/styles/base.css guard dialogs against narrow-screen overflow: confirm .modal-scrim keeps padding + overflow-y:auto, and ensure the dialog card can't exceed the viewport width (e.g. a max-width:100% / width guard on the dialog content) without changing the Modal a11y contract. Confirm ScheduleGrid horizontal scroll and MonthCalendar dot mode (<=640px) still behave; only extend existing patterns.
Keep all edits minimal and cohesive: prefer token + CSS-class changes over component rewrites; preserve aria-current, aria-label='Primary', focus-visible ring, sr-only, and prefers-reduced-motion.
acceptance_criteria: On a touch viewport, the bar tabs, account-control buttons, and board view-toggle buttons have ~44px minimum tap height; desktop (pointer:fine) layout is visually unchanged.

At 320/375px there is no horizontal page overflow and board/dialog spacing is comfortable (not cramped); schedule grid still scrolls horizontally and the month calendar still shows dot mode at <=640px.
No colors are hardcoded; light/dark theming and WCAG-AA posture are preserved; no data flow, auth, or feature behavior changed.
All existing dialog/account tests still pass with assertions unchanged.
verification: Run `npm run typecheck` in c:\Users\paulc\Projects\ToDoS\.worktrees\nav-redesign and confirm it exits 0.
Run `npm run test` in the worktree and confirm all tests pass (no weakened assertions; count >= FEAT-001 result).
Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint` in the worktree and confirm both succeed.
findings: Done. All changes are additive, token-only (no colors added/changed), desktop layout unchanged. CSS edits in src/styles/base.css: (1) new `@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)` block giving .topbar-tabs button, .account-btn and .board-view-btn min-height:44px + 0.5rem vertical padding, plus min-width:44px on the square icon/auth buttons (.account-btn.header-auth-btn and the Appearance-settings icon button) — fires only on coarse-pointer/no-hover devices so pointer:fine desktops are untouched; (2) extended the existing @media (max-width:860px) .board-main rule with padding:0.75rem; gap:0.75rem (single-column collapse + schedule->details->list DOM order unchanged); (3) added dialog overflow guard `.modal-scrim > * { max-width:100% }` just after .modal-scrim (which already keeps padding:1rem + overflow-y:auto) so a fixed rem max-width dialog card can't exceed the padded scrim at 320px — Modal.tsx a11y contract (role=dialog/focus trap/Escape) untouched. Component edits added className hooks only (no behavior/aria/label/token changes): src/components/AccountControls.tsx — added className="account-btn" to the Appearance icon button and the officer Members button, and "account-btn" alongside the existing "header-auth-btn" on both sign-in and sign-out buttons; src/components/BoardViewToggle.tsx — added className="board-view-btn" to both toggle buttons. The <=640px icon-only auth sizing (height/width:2rem) is intentionally overridden to 44px on touch via min-height/min-width (min-* wins over the smaller fixed size). ScheduleGrid horizontal scroll and MonthCalendar dot mode (<=640px) left as-is (only existing patterns extended). Integration note: new class names available for any further polish are .account-btn and .board-view-btn. Verification from worktree root: typecheck exit 0; test = 175 passed / 17 skipped (matches FEAT-001); build succeeded; lint = 0 errors (3 pre-existing react-refresh warnings in context/*Provider.tsx, not touched).
